_what: THE INTAKE GATE. One entry per panel or table that supplies a VALUE. Filled BEFORE any digitiser or any chemistry was written.
_why: NG_2025 (publisher Source Data) and WT_2026 (author repo) have ZERO digitisation defects between them. The four curations that digitised have eight value-changing findings: F-006, F-008, F-017, F-018, F-019, F-020, F-033, F-040.

_tiers.1_publisher_source_data: a Source Data file published with the paper
_tiers.2_si_tables: an xlsx/csv/docx table in the supplementary information
_tiers.3_author_repository: the authors' own repo, Zenodo, Dryad, figshare
_tiers.4_pdf_text_table: a real text table inside the PDF (pdfplumber)
_tiers.4b_pdf_vector_geometry: NOT one of the five canonical tiers. The value is carried by the PDF's OWN filled-rectangle coordinates (pymupdf page.get_drawings()), read in PDF user space. No raster is produced and no pixel is sampled; the axis is calibrated from the same vector tick-line coordinates. Strictly stronger than 5_pixels (no resampling, no JPEG, no antialiasing, no colour matching) and strictly weaker than 1-3 (the author still rounded the number into a drawing). Recorded as its own key rather than folded into 4 or 5 so a reviewer is not told it is a text table and is not told it is pixels.
_tiers.5_pixels: digitised from a raster figure. THE LAST RESORT.

_rule: A panel recorded as 5_pixels MUST fill why_tiers_1_to_4_failed with a sentence a reviewer can check. 'Not available' is not such a sentence.

_library_first.breakdown: 9 OCholB (heads 75,76,77,78,80,81,87,90,304) + 3 O16B (75,76,77) + 3 OChol (75,76,77) + 3 single-tailed OCholB-1 (75,76,77). 'N lipids' in this paper is NOT N formulations: 75-OCholB-F etc. are the SAME structure as 75-OCholB formulated 1/1 w/w with DOPE, and are counted as formulations, not structures.
_library_first.how_established: SI Figure S13 and Figure S16 are TEXT tables giving the [M+H]+ molecular formula of every fully-substituted lipidoid. Nine OCholB formulas are listed; the main text independently says 'six out of the nine examined OCholB LNPs'. The library size was not stated anywhere in prose.

panels.supplies: GFP mRNA transfection efficacy, % GFP+ cells, 12 groups x 4 cell lines = 48 bars. 9 are library members (75,76,77,78,80,81,87,90,304-OCholB); 3 are controls (Lpf2k, naked mRNA, untreated). Cell lines HeLa / B16F10 / HEK293 / NIH 3T3.
panels.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: 1: Angew. Chem. 2020 published no Source Data file for this article; the only supplementary deposit on the Wiley record is anie202004994-sup-0001-misc_information.pdf, a 58-page narrative PDF with no workbook. 2: that SI PDF contains exactly three text tables, extracted from the text layer of all 58 pages -- Figure S13 and Figure S16 (MS formulas) and Figure S35 (brain-region acronyms); none carries a transfection value. 3: find_repo.py --doi 10.1002/anie.202004994 --pmid 32438474 --author Xu returned no matching repository. 4: Figure 3 is a MAIN-TEXT figure, so it is not in the SI PDF at all and has no vector copy we can reach; PMC serves it only as a raster. The vector original lives in the Wiley article PDF, which is behind a bot check, and this task forbids bypassing bot checks and forbids using the shared browser.
panels.verified_against: two printed statistics in the Results text -- Lpf2k is stated as 98% GFP+ HeLa cells and naked GFP mRNA as 2% GFP+ HeLa cells. Both are bars in this panel, so they are an axis check external to our geometry. Also: the qualitative claim '75-, 77-, 78-, 80-, and 81-OCholB deliver to all cell types; 87- and 90-OCholB are consistently ineffective' is a 9x4 ordering claim the extracted matrix must satisfy.

panels.supplies: (-30)GFP-Cre PROTEIN delivery, % GFP+ cells in HeLa-DsRed, 12 groups x 3 protein concentrations (25 / 50 / 100 nM) = 36 bars. DIFFERENT CARGO from Figure 3B and therefore a different experiment.
panels.locator: anie202004994-sup-0001-misc_information.pdf page 37 (printed S36); 36 filled rectangles with baseline y1 = 340.23 pt
panels.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: Tiers 1-3 fail for the whole paper for the reasons given under Figure 3B. Tier 4 fails because the panel is a drawing, not a text table. It does NOT fall to tier 5: the bars are native PDF vector rectangles, so their tops are exact numbers in PDF user space.
panels.verified_against: the Results text states 'Six out of the nine examined OCholB LNPs showed comparable or even higher transfection efficiency than Lpf2k' -- a 9-vs-1 count the extracted values must reproduce.

panels.supplies: gene-recombination efficiency, % DsRed+ cells in HeLa-DsRed, 12 groups x 3 protein concentrations = 36 bars. A DOWNSTREAM functional readout of the same protein delivery, not a second measurement of delivery.
panels.locator: same page; 36 filled rectangles with baseline y1 = 510.76 pt
panels.verified_against: 'Six of the nine examined OCholB LNPs were comparable or even more efficient than Lpf2k'; and the Results' separate claim that unformulated OCholB LNPs achieved 49-73% DsRed+ cells for Cre mRNA (a different panel, Figure S21B) must NOT be confused with this one.

panels.supplies: mean green fluorescence intensity, a.u., 12 single bars.
panels.locator: same page; 12 filled rectangles with baseline y1 = 510.62 pt
panels.verified_against: NOT EMITTED. The panel carries no legend and the caption names no protein concentration, so the condition behind these 12 numbers is unstated. Recorded in 08_contradictions.csv; see DECISIONS.md D-3.

panels.supplies: LNP/mRNA weight-ratio optimisation for 75-OCholB only (7 ratios + control).
panels.verified_against: NOT EMITTED -- a single-lipid dose-response, not a library screen. It does, however, pin the delivery condition used everywhere else (LNP/mRNA = 10/1 w/w).
NOT EMITTED. Viability is not a delivery endpoint; the corpus's 90 hemolysis_percent rows were excluded from LNPDB for the same reason (CLAUDE.md changelog 2026-07-23).

panels.supplies: nothing numeric per lipid. Fluorescence micrographs and IVIS images only; Figure 7B is a GFAP/NeuN colocalisation percentage of tdTomato+ cells, not a delivery measurement.
panels.verified_against: NO IN VIVO VALUE IS EXTRACTABLE FROM THIS PAPER. Every in vivo result is reported as a presence/absence of tdTomato signal in an image. There is no axis, no scale bar of intensity, and no table. Stated plainly rather than estimated.

verdict: USABLE. 36 library values from Figure 3B (mRNA, 4 cell lines, tier 5) and 27 + 27 from Figure S24C/S24F (protein, 3 doses, tier 4b vector). ZERO in vivo values.
